module: Node "Screen Main Header" (repeat_instant, color ui). Adds a large header to the screen (usually the mission name). Inputs: flow, header (string), preHeader (string, e.g. the mission type). Output: flow (chainFlow).
notes: The preHeader pin has "Header" as its default value (same as header).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

work.desc: Copies flow then calls modules.ui:addHeader({header=..., preHeader=...}).
